STOP-BANG Score for OSA

Screens for obstructive sleep apnea

Original: Chung F et al. Anesthesiology 2008
Validation: Surgical population, >10,000 patients
OSA Risk:
• 0-2: Low risk
• 3-4: Intermediate risk
• 5-8: High risk
Sensitivity:
• ≥3 for moderate-severe OSA: 93%
• ≥5 for severe OSA: 100%
Next Steps: High risk → sleep study (polysomnography)
